keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Anthony Lopes (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Haris Belkebla (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Paris FC 1, Angers 0. Patrick Zabi (Paris FC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Diego Coppola with a headed pass following a corner.
Goal! Paris FC 2, Angers 0. Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Angers. Jim Allevinah replaces Anthony Bermont.
Substitution, Angers. Amine El Ouazzani replaces Usman Simbakoli.
Substitution, Angers. Lilian Raolisoa replaces Carlens Arcus.
Delay in match (Paris FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paris FC 3, Angers 0. Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Paris FC. Jonathan Ikoné replaces Ilan Kebbal.
Substitution, Paris FC. Adama Camara replaces Rudy Matondo.
Delay in match because of an injury Pablo Pagis (Paris FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paris FC 4, Angers 0. Diego Coppola (Paris FC) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pablo Pagis with a cross following a set piece situation.
Jim Allevinah (Angers) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Angers. Emmanuel Biumla replaces Amine Sbaï.
Substitution, Paris FC. Jean-Philippe Krasso replaces Pablo Pagis.
Substitution, Paris FC. Moustapha Mbow replaces Samir Chergui.
Substitution, Paris FC. Vincent Marchetti replaces Maxime Lopez.
Substitution, Angers. Jules Bouffandeau replaces Yassin Belkhdim.
Delay in match (Paris FC).
Delay in match (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Paris FC 4, Angers 0.
